title: 苏州平江路的一天：从晨光到灯笼｜A Day on Pingjiang Road, Suzhou
description:
天刚亮，平江路还在睡。一条河，一条街，并肩走了八百年——1229年的《平江图》上，它就是这个样子。石桥、乌篷船、枕河的人家。唐代杜荀鹤写过：君到姑苏见，人家尽枕河。拐进小巷，一碗苏式汤面冒着热气；茶馆里，评弹的三弦响起来，吴侬软语，唱着六百年前的故事。黄昏，灯笼一盏盏亮起，河水把灯影揉碎，又慢慢拼回去。上有天堂，下有苏杭。一条街走完，像走过了整个江南。

A dawn-to-dusk walk down Pingjiang Road (平江路) in Suzhou — an 800-year-old canal street that already appears, unchanged, on the 1229 map 《平江图》. Stone bridges, black-awning boats, and houses "pillowed on the river," just as the Tang poet Du Xunhe described. Turn into a lane for a bowl of clear Suzhou noodles; in a teahouse the pingtan strings sound and the soft Wu dialect sings tales six centuries old. At dusk the lanterns light and the canal breaks their reflections, then mends them. "Heaven above; below, Suzhou and Hangzhou."

关于方言 / On dialect: 平江路在苏州，说的是苏州话（吴语），本片以评弹·吴侬软语呈现当地语言，未冒充其他方言。/ Suzhou speaks the Wu dialect (not Shanghainese); the local voice here is Suzhou Pingtan, labeled honestly.

本片无旁白：以中英双语字幕叙述，配免版税古筝音乐。/ No voiceover — narrated through bilingual subtitles over a royalty-free guzheng bed (no AI narration in this video).
